## Setup

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, brms, tidybayes)

# shared with 03 and 05: species linpreds, subadult - adult contrasts, f_draw_agg summaries
source(here("size_bd_unified", "contrast_functions.R"))

```

## Compute contrasts per cutoff

Compare species contrast estimates across Bd load cutoffs (copies per swab). The cutoff
used in the main analysis (co100) is chosen a priori; the others are a sensitivity analysis.
Cutoff models are not compared by LOO, since each cutoff changes the response data.
Contrasts are computed here from each cutoff model with the same code as 03
(contrast_functions.R). Models are loaded one at a time (~850 MB each); the per-cutoff
summaries are cached to intermediates/th_sensitivity_analysis/ so the models only need to be
loaded again when a model file changes.

```{r}
cutoffs = c("co0", "co30", "co100", "co300", "co1000")

model_dir = here("size_bd_unified", "unified_models")
cache_dir = here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "th_sensitivity_analysis")
if (!dir.exists(cache_dir)) dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# latest m11d fit per cutoff (file names end in _YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_with_loo.rds)
model_files = tibble(file = list.files(model_dir, pattern = "^unified_model_results_zln_m11d_co[0-9]+_.*_with_loo\\.rds$")) %>%
  mutate(cutoff = str_extract(file, "co[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(cutoff %in% cutoffs) %>%
  group_by(cutoff) %>%
  slice_max(file, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

model_files

missing_cutoffs = setdiff(cutoffs, model_files$cutoff)
if (length(missing_cutoffs) > 0) {
  stop("No model file for cutoff(s): ", paste(missing_cutoffs, collapse = ", "))
}

# contrasts for one cutoff, cached by model file name
f_cutoff_contrasts = function(co, file) {
  cache_file = file.path(cache_dir, paste0("combined_agg_", sub("\\.rds$", "", file), ".csv"))

  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(read_csv(cache_file, show_col_types = FALSE))
  }

  model = readRDS(file.path(model_dir, file))
  stopifnot(model_response(model) == paste0("bd_load_", co, "_density"))

  combined_agg = spp_contrasts(model)$combined_agg
  rm(model)
  gc()

  write_csv(combined_agg, cache_file)
  combined_agg
}

th_combined = map2_dfr(model_files$cutoff, model_files$file, function(co, file) {
  f_cutoff_contrasts(co, file) %>%
    mutate(threshold = co)
}) %>%
  mutate(threshold = factor(threshold, levels = cutoffs))

```

## Reshape

Pivot each contrast's median/50%/95% interval columns into a common long format
so each can be plotted as a boxplot summary (box = 50% CI, whiskers = 95% CI,
midline = median).

```{r}
param_prefixes = c("hu_contrast", "mu_contrast")

th_long = map_dfr(param_prefixes, function(p) {
  th_combined %>%
    select(taxon_capture, threshold, contrast,
           lower_95 = paste0(p, "_lower_95"),
           lower_50 = paste0(p, "_lower_50"),
           median = paste0(p, "_median"),
           upper_50 = paste0(p, "_upper_50"),
           upper_95 = paste0(p, "_upper_95"),
           net_effect = paste0(p, "_net_effect"),
           support = paste0(p, "_support")) %>%
    mutate(parameter = p)
}) %>%
  filter(!is.na(median))  # species without an estimable mu contrast

```

## Agreement across cutoffs

Per species and contrast: does the direction (sign of the median) or support class
change across cutoffs?

```{r}
th_agreement = th_long %>%
  group_by(parameter, taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(n_cutoffs = n(),
            sign_agrees = n_distinct(sign(median)) == 1,
            support_agrees = n_distinct(support) == 1,
            direction_by_cutoff = paste(if_else(median > 0, "+", "-"), collapse = " "),
            support_by_cutoff = paste(support, collapse = " / "),
            net_effect_by_cutoff = paste(round(net_effect, 2), collapse = " / "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(parameter, sign_agrees, support_agrees, taxon_capture)

th_agreement

th_agreement %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(n_species = n(),
            n_sign_agrees = sum(sign_agrees),
            n_support_agrees = sum(support_agrees),
            .groups = "drop")

```

## Boxplot comparison by species

```{r}
#| fig.height: 8
#| fig.width: 10

plot_th_comparison = function(param) {
  th_long %>%
    filter(parameter == param) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, fill = threshold)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#555") +
    geom_boxplot(aes(ymin = lower_95, lower = lower_50, middle = median,
                      upper = upper_50, ymax = upper_95),
                 stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap("taxon_capture", scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = param, y = param, x = "cutoff") +
    theme_minimal()
}

```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 16
#| fig.width: 12
plot_th_comparison("hu_contrast")

```

```{r}
#| fig.height: 16
#| fig.width: 12
plot_th_comparison("mu_contrast")

```
